goal: Recursively test which current psychiatric groupings are best represented as distinct diseases, biological endotypes, dimensions/spectra, stages, treatment-response states, operational categories, or composite multiaxial structures.
rules: Do not privilege DSM, ICD, HiTOP, RDoC, genomic factors, or any existing nosology a priori.
Etiologically defined diseases are peeled off only when frozen distinct-disease gates are met.
Residual groups cannot be promoted by exclusion alone; U09 applies.
Cross-diagnostic endotypes are allowed and should not be forced back inside legacy diagnoses.
Dimensions, longitudinal stages, treatment-response states, and context are orthogonal axes unless evidence shows otherwise.
Current diagnoses may remain operational clinical categories even when they do not map to distinct biological diseases.
Target-family holdout must be used when a specific downstream diagnostic family is tested in depth.
